patch_description: This crossover retains the single shared collective RY parameter and the current program’s connected ring entanglement, while removing the redundant second rotation layer. The two complementary CZ matchings cover every qubit and connect the full register without adding parameters. This preserves one trainable mode per repeated block while reducing the per-block gate count from 24 to 16 and the logical depth from four layers to three, targeting faster execution with comparable accuracy and generalization.
